notes: status=success applies only to local mock protocol verification. It must not be read as real Feishu/QQ integration success. Feishu production ingress uses the official @larksuiteoapi/node-sdk WSClient; the self-written frame codec is test-only. QQ remains a minimal documented adapter checked against active official plugins/SDKs. Bot secrets were never present in this run: mock credentials are fixed fake values and results/logs are redacted. See tests/phase0/bot-connectors.md for protocol details and blockers.
